More so and widespread in the Tees Valley, in particular the South Tees region. So much so it was named one of the 12 local delivery pilots (LDPs) by Sport England (Sport England, 2021) to improve Health Outcomes (led by You 6ve Got This (2020). Across this area it ranks as one of the highest in the index of multiple deprivation (IMD) deprived councils and subsequent wards in England for the last 20 years. This revitalised space not only improves the aesthetics of the area but also provides a place where people can gather to improve their health and quality of life. Our commitment to inclusivity ensures that the gym accommodates individuals with diverse needs, making fitness and wellness accessible to all.  Helping People Reach Their Potential  "The £1 Gym" equips individuals with the tools, resources, and support they need to lead healthy and fulfilling lives. Through affordable fitness options, comprehensive wellness services, and personalised support, we empower individuals to prioritise their physical and mental health, setting them on a path toward long-term success and wellbeing from an early stage.  Supporting Communities Facing Challenges  Amid the cost-of-living crisis, many individuals and communities are struggling with increased demands and challenges. "The £1 Gym" alleviates some of these pressures by offering affordable fitness and wellness services that are accessible to all, regardless of financial constraints. By removing barriers to health and wellbeing, we support communities in overcoming challenges and building resilience in the face of adversity.

Any surplus will be re-invested into the CIC for community programmes.

name: SCP WAREHOUSE HUB C.I.C.
description: SCP Hub will provide volunteering and work experience opportunities for young people and adults in areas like warehousing, logistics, forklift truck operation, and customer service. Community Benefit: These opportunities will help individuals gain valuable skills and experience, increasing their employability and enhancing personal development within the local workforce. Unlike commercial warehousing providers, which charge premium rates that are often unaffordable for community organizations, SCP Warehouse Hub prioritizes accessibility. Its pricing model ensures that local groups, especially those serving vulnerable populations, can access storage and operational space without financial strain. Any income generated will be reinvested to expand the Hub's capacity and further enhance its community impact.  Community Impact: By removing the high costs associated with commercial warehousing and fostering partnerships with local industries, SCP Warehouse Hub empowers organizations to:  Deliver impactful projects without the burden of excessive storage costs. Gain access to surplus materials and resources donated by nearby businesses. Support vulnerable residents through initiatives like food banks and donation drives. Encourage creativity and cultural engagement via accessible event spaces. Build a stronger, more resilient community through corporate-social responsibility initiatives. The South Hartlepool and Seal Sands area is home to a wide variety of industries, including chemicals, manufacturing, logistics, and energy. The region is an industrial hotspot, with many large businesses that generate surplus materials, providing SCP Hub with an opportunity to bridge the gap between local industries and the voluntary sector. This allows businesses to contribute to community-driven projects while fulfilling their CSR objectives, thus directly benefiting local organizations and the Teesside community, which is home to over 370,000 residents. By repurposing materials and facilitating corporate partnerships, SCP Warehouse Hub will create a network that strengthens both local industries and community organizations alike.
